findings.title: Legacy navMs includes a fixed two-second delay
findings.what: The timer starts immediately before hash navigation, then the code unconditionally waits 2,000 ms before calculating navMs. The emitted navMs therefore measures the fixed settling delay plus overhead, not navigation or first-paint latency, making per-view results and comparisons non-reproducible as the claimed metric.
findings.fix: Calculate the metric from browser performance timestamps already captured by the injected instrumentation, or stop the timer on an explicit render-ready condition; keep any post-render settling delay outside the reported interval.
findings.acceptance: Run the legacy probe against a deterministic fixture where render completion is instrumented below 500 ms and verify emitted navMs tracks that timestamp rather than remaining near 2,000 ms; add a focused test proving a changed settling delay does not change navMs.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed t0 is set at line 366, the only intervening completion gate is waitForTimeout(2000) at line 372, navMs is calculated afterward at line 374, and that value is printed as navMs at line 894. No subtraction or alternate timing source corrects it.
